comment: The README declares this module deprecated and says it cannot be added from the module browser; the installed plugin.json carries no hidden flag for it and src/Ohmer.cpp:22 registers it normally, so it does appear in the browser. That is worth a person checking in the running Rack. Only two of the module's controls exist as parameters: the encoder at src/KlokSpid.cpp:332, configured with infinite limits, and the button at :333-334. Everything else is a SETUP page drawn on the display and driven by those two, which means no other setting can be reached by clicking, and the right-click menu holds only the Model submenu. The ratio list is the 31 values at :107, running from 64 down to 1/64. The CV mapping is at :987-993: the clamped voltage is multiplied by 12.6 and rounded, which is what steps it through the list. Output level choices are at :561-578 and the option to put an LFO waveform on the fourth jack at :1272-1285, available only while that jack is at ratio x1. Because SETUP is a screen rather than a set of controls, the settings it holds are written as Note lines and only the ones that could be read straight from the source are given.
